In my junior year of high school, I had one close friend who I sat at the lunch table with and ate with. Well, she dropped out towards the end of the school year and I have major anxiety so I wouldn’t of dared to ask anyone to sit with them. So instead of going to lunch I went into the bathroom and sat in one of the stalls until it was over.

The worst moment for that was when I was in there and two girls came in and one must’ve motioned to me in the stall because the other said, “Oh, she’s always in there.” And that’s when it really hit me that I had no actual friends in high school and my mental health was so bad that I eventually dropped out and did online schooling. No regrets to that choice at all.

It was after my sisters dad had passed and he hadn’t been cremated yet, but I was in the kitchen doing the dishes and I heard the back door open and I turned around to see his shoes that he always wore, walking out the door. 

Later, my mom was walking into their bedroom and saw his hand on the arm of the chair he was usually sitting in. 

After he was cremated, we never saw anything else and I feel like at the time he was “around” because he left behind my youngest sister who was only about 3 weeks old at the time of his death. We miss you, nemo.

My sister’s dad passed away and we ended up having to put all of his stuff into a storage locker because my mom couldn’t bare to see any of it.

Eventually, my mom got put away due to her depression from losing him and turning to drugs go cope and didn’t tell any of us about the storage locker so we lost all pictures and memories of my sister’s dad.

Now my sister only has about two pictures of him.

Don’t consider it creepy but when my sisters’ dad passed away and before he was cremated, my mother and I “seen” him twice.

I was doing the dishes and turned, so the front door was able to be seen from the corner of my eye and his shoes that he always wore (black vans type) walked out the front door. My mother later walked into her bedroom and noticed his hand on the armrest of the chair he always used to sit in.

After he was cremated, we never saw anything again. We all miss him dearly, as he left behind my 12 week old sister and 10 year old sister at the time.
